integrity.computation: No finite experiment is used as proof.
integrity.proof_mode: scheme-theoretic finite-flat rank comparison plus classification of divisible abelian groups

scientific_limitations: The fraction field is algebraically closed.
Only the torsion subgroup of the divisible component group is determined; a torsion-free divisible summand is not classified.

The classical rank-one direct-limit theorem of Grothendieck is a close analogue; the claim concerns the actual component group over arbitrary-rank valuation rings and permits nonzero generic torus rank.
title: Component torsion measures the torus-rank jump in higher-rank Néron models
